# Bongshai Group (bongshai.com) AI Guidelines & Index

> Bongshai Group is a premier diversified conglomerate based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, managing market-leading subsidiaries across EPC&C contracting, structural steel fabrication, residential real estate, digital e-commerce, and community philanthropy.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: Bongshai Group
- **Main Portal**: https://bongshai.com
- **Founder & CEO**: S. M. Awal (CEO & Chief Structural Engineer)
- **Founded**: 2008
- **Headquarters**: Sector 3, Uttara Model Town, Dhaka-1230, Bangladesh
- **Official Contact**: info@bongshai.com

## Dedicated Subsidiary Pages
1. **Bongshai Engineering**: Turnkey EPC&C contractor handling civil infrastructure, high-rise structural engineering, and industrial power plants
   - Internal Profile: https://bongshai.com/engineering.html
   - External Portal: https://bongshaiengineering.com
2. **Bongshai Housing**: Luxury residential real estate, gated communities, and modern pre-engineered villas
   - Internal Profile: https://bongshai.com/housing.html
   - External Portal: https://bongshaihousing.com
3. **Bongshai Steel**: Heavy structural steel fabrication, pre-engineered buildings (PEB), and industrial factory sheds
   - Internal Profile: https://bongshai.com/steel.html
   - External Portal: https://bongshaisteel.com
4. **Bongshai Express**: Rapid e-commerce marketplace and digital supply chain logistics network
   - Internal Profile: https://bongshai.com/express.html
   - External Portal: https://bongshaixpress.com
5. **Bongshai Foundation**: Dedicated philanthropic arm financing STEM scholarships, flood disaster relief, and rural healthcare clinics
   - Internal Profile: https://bongshai.com/foundation.html
   - External Portal: https://bongshaifoundation.org
